blogs.title: How Does a Nuclear Reactor Produce Power?
blogs.title_hi: न्यूक्लियर रिएक्टर बिजली कैसे उत्पन्न करता है?
blogs.content:
A nuclear reactor is a complex system that harnesses the energy produced by nuclear fission to generate electricity. In simple terms, when the nucleus of an atom, usually uranium or plutonium, is split, it releases a significant amount of thermal energy. This process is carefully controlled within the reactor to maintain a steady output of power while ensuring safety.

The heat generated from fission is used to convert water into steam, which then drives turbines connected to generators, ultimately producing electricity. Understanding the mechanics behind this process is essential for grasping how nuclear energy contributes to our power grid.

blogs.title: How Does Solar Energy Work? Understanding the Basics
blogs.title_hi: सौर ऊर्जा कैसे काम करती है? मूल बातें समझें
blogs.content:
Solar energy is a renewable source of energy harnessed from the sun's rays. This clean energy is not only abundant but also sustainable, making it an ideal choice for powering homes and businesses. By converting sunlight into electricity, solar technology reduces our reliance on fossil fuels and minimizes our carbon footprint.

Understanding how solar energy works involves learning about solar panels, inverters, and the overall solar power system. This blog will delve into the mechanics of solar energy, its benefits, and how it can be effectively utilized in our daily lives.
